name: AI가 찾아줘도 다시 확인해야 하는 이유
prompt: Create a wide 16:9 explanatory editorial illustration for an internal corporate newsletter. Use clean flat vector shapes, subtle paper texture, warm ivory background, navy outlines, teal accents, and muted orange for conflicting or outdated information. Arrange one clear workplace story from left to right. On the left, a shared-document window and a team-chat window contain conflicting versions of the same cancellation rule: both use a parcel with a return-arrow pictogram, but one has a fully shaded unnumbered clock face and the other a half-shaded clock face. In the center, a small AI assistant retrieves the older orange rule card from the shared document and presents that exact card to an employee; visually repeat its pictograms so the copied source is obvious. On the right, the uncertain employee turns to a busy colleague, who searches a thick stack of past records. An hourglass between the two people makes the additional waiting visible. Use restrained connecting arrows and ample whitespace to clarify the sequence: conflicting sources, an unreliable AI answer, and human verification. Keep expressions and office details simple. No text, letters, numbers, punctuation, logos, or watermarks anywhere.
anchor: 결재를 올리려는데 공유 문서와 팀 메신저에 적힌 기준이 서로 다릅니다.

name: 회의의 결정이 최신 기준이 되는 과정
prompt: Create a wide 16:9 explanatory editorial illustration in exactly this style: clean flat vector shapes, subtle paper texture, warm ivory background, navy outlines, teal accents, and muted orange for outdated information. Show a clear left-to-right workflow with five spacious visual stages connected by simple arrows. First, coworkers conclude a meeting; a meeting-record sheet contains a newly agreed teal rule tile, represented by a parcel with a return-arrow pictogram and a half-shaded unnumbered clock face. Second, a software interface extracts that same teal tile and presents it to a responsible employee, who deliberately clicks a checkmark-only approval button. Make this human approval step prominent. Third, one large central reference document is updated: the approved teal tile moves into its rule slot while the previous orange tile moves into a small archive tray underneath. This is a single maintained document, not a pile of copies. Fourth, a small AI assistant reads directly from that updated reference document. Fifth, several coworkers receive matching teal rule tiles from the assistant and continue their work. Repeat the identical new-rule pictogram throughout to make information continuity unmistakable. The arrows must pass through human approval before reaching the reference document. No text, letters, numbers, punctuation, logos, or watermarks anywhere.
anchor: 그래서 별도로 도구를 익히지 않아도 쓸 수 있는 플랫폼을 만들고, 기준
